PO9MfV comp-ly5hf69m wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">TPOXX is a highly targeted antiviral with a strong safety profile. It prevents viral particles from exiting the cell in which they are produced, thereby slowing the spread of infection, and allowing the patient’s immune system to clear the virus.</span></p>

<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"> </p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:22px;"><span style="font-size:22px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Oral TPOXX was the first U.S. FDA-approved antiviral treatment for smallpox. It is also available in an IV formulation. In Canada, oral TPOXX is approved for the same indication. In the EU, as well as Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein, TPOXX, known as Tecovirimat SIGA, is approved for the treatment of smallpox, cowpox, and vaccinia complications following vaccination against smallpox. In the UK and Japan, under the brand names Tecovirimat SIGA and TEPOXX, respectively, the antiviral is approved for the treatment of orthopoxvirus infections, including mpox, smallpox, cowpox, and vaccinia complications following vaccination against smallpox.</span></p>

<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text"> <br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
